name: Here's Your Meal!
descriptionTemplate: Remove the {Stagnation} state from all cards in hand. Restore [Heal:Arg1] HP. Add 1 {derived:Marvelous Cuisine} to your hand. Inflict [{Poison}:Arg2] {plural:[{Poison}:Arg2]|stack|stacks} of {Poison} on all enemies.
lore:
One, two... one, two...
She carried a tray, weaving through the crowd to a light rhythm.
The guests drank and sang without pause; she served and smiled without end.
Everything here was golden. A golden hall, golden wine, and golden dresses.
Karen adored gold. She flashed her well-practiced signature smile.
"Please enjoy your meal, dear guest—!!"
